title: default_budget orphaned in balance.json after the r2 inventory pivot
evidence:
"default_budget": 5200,   [data/balance.json:26]
Verification: grep -rn "default_budget" --include="*.odin" across the worktree -> 0 references. core/catalog.odin parses "starting_inventory" (l.375) and "grants" (l.395) but has no default_budget case — the key is silently ignored by the loader.
detail: The r2 inventory pivot (0b92fa4) removed the budget but left default_budget in balance.json. The loader never parses it; zero .odin references. Dead knob that still triggers catalog-hash drift on edit — pure re-bless bait.
recommended_fix: Delete the default_budget line from data/balance.json and re-bless the goldens (the inventory replaced the budget per the user ruling), so the catalog stops advertising a knob that does nothing.
